observations: Steal An Egg (94 days) still leads, ahead of Brookhaven, 99 Nights in the Forest, Murder Mystery 2, RIVALS and +1 Speed Keyboard Escape.

Seven games entered, including It Hears The Water (13 days), Pave the Road (44 days), Demonology and Welcome to Bloxburg; BedWars Part 2, Kick a Lucky Block and Adopt Your Animal! fell off.

patterns: Games left more than about 11 days without an update stay fewer days on the chart (r=-0.61 at the split); H-mp-018 at 65% tends to hold.

Three of the five biggest risers are wave-survival games (Dead Rails, Survive Overnight in a Mega Store, What If Disasters) even though that loop sits at only the 34th median percentile, which suggests seasonal events lift it for a short time.
Solo loops consistently hold lower positions than social ones (H-mp-003 at 75%), and more original concepts consistently rank higher (H-mp-013 at 75%).

In the video set, social and PvP hits keep a light HUD (Brookhaven, RIVALS, Adopt Me!) while progression hits run a dense one (Blox Fruits, Emergency Hamburg), so HUD density follows the loop rather than success.

summary: Physics sandboxes and horror lead both breakout charts again: two ragdoll games sit in the top four of Up-and-Coming and among the best Top Trending climbers, and horror_escape is the largest loop on Up-and-Coming.

Games pull players first and monetize later: games 14 days or younger lead Up-and-Coming (94th percentile) and Top Trending (77th) while Top Earning efficiency climbs from the 2nd percentile at 0–14 days to the 60th past a year.
Updating often is the most consistent cross-chart signal: days since update goes against Most Popular, Top Trending and Up-and-Coming at once.
Halloween events lift older games across charts (Dead Rails, Survive Overnight in a Mega Store, The Mimic, Pet Simulator X), a seasonal confounder for update and age hypotheses this week.
progressions: uc→tt remains the most common transition (111 entries, median 2 days), ahead of tt→mp (105, 2 days).
uc→te (76, 5 days), tt→te (72, 4 days), te→tt (70, 9 days) and uc→mp (65, 4 days) show breakouts reaching revenue and dominance within about a week, while tt→uc stays at 1.

Sound-hunting horror, where a blind monster tracks noise (don't splash, don't speak), is a wave that puts several young games at the top of Up-and-Coming and Top Trending within their first weeks
hypotheses.action: Build horror around one noise rule

evidence.rationale: DONT SPLASH still leads Up-and-Coming at 10 days, It Hears The Water entered Most Popular at 13 days, and two new games (FATHOM, Steal Or Die) build their monster around hearing players' footsteps and microphones; FATHOM's monster even talks back. The broader horror wave remains a confounder.

evidence.rationale: The Hollow (14 days, no passes or products) sits among the best on Up-and-Coming, and Steal Or Die's thumbnails advertise 'The Hollow, 1 of 5 entities', showing participating games use the event in their marketing.

hypotheses.statement: Games built on a fandom's existing IP or a close look-alike (Adventure Time TD, My Little Pony horror, Warrior Cats, Vampire Diaries roleplay, Sword Art Online, Thanos) reach Top Earning with modest player counts by selling canon characters, roles and early access

evidence.rationale: Undertale Adventures X (830 days, a tower defense on a game fandom) entered Top Earning and Candy Kingdom Defense (Adventure Time) rose +133. Two more data points, still untested by the scan.

Complete ports of proven off-platform formats (rated chess with engine review, a Ragnarok-style MMORPG, a Terraria-inspired pixel roguelike, Katamari-style rolling) reach Top Trending or Top Earning without leaning on Roblox templates
hypotheses.action: Port a proven off-platform format in full

evidence.rationale: RoChess (26 days, 18.1M visits) is on Top Trending and Up-and-Coming; Pixel Lineage (32 days, 99% likes) is Top Earning #95 with a single game pass; roll the world leads Top Trending momentum (+34); Hunting Together RPG reached Top Earning at 23 days. Confirm if more such ports appear and whether they hold for several weeks; the counter case would be ports that stall below the charts.

hypotheses.statement: Greed-versus-risk extraction loops, where loot slows you down or a quota deadline looms while a threat hunts you (Steal Or Die, Criminal Simulator), reach Top Earning and Up-and-Coming within their first weeks
hypotheses.action: Make players trade loot against escape

evidence.rationale: Steal Or Die (48 days) is Top Earning #205 and sells cash packs up to 5,999 R$; Criminal Simulator (19 days, Lethal Company-style debt quota) entered Up-and-Coming at #69 with 22 badges. Two cases only; confirm with more extraction or quota games and their positions over the next two weeks.
